title: Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks for Sensing-Aided Beam Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.12507v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sensing-aided beam prediction can reduce the beam-training overhead of millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems by leveraging environmental information from complementary modalities such as vision and position. However, the resulting sensing and inference pipeline can be energy-intensive, motivating the use of energy-efficient spiking neural networks (SNNs) as an alternative to conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs). In this work, we develop SNN architectures for beam prediction and systematically compare them with ANNs using position-only, vision-only, and multimodal inputs. Our results show that compact ANNs consistently outperform SNNs for position-only sensing. In contrast, for vision and multimodal sensing, SNNs achieve higher accuracy than ANNs at similar energy costs and require up to an order of magnitude less energy at a comparable accuracy. translated_title: 用于传感辅助波束预测的高能效脉冲神经网络
translated_abstract: 传感辅助波束预测可以利用视觉和位置等互补模态提供的环境信息，减少毫米波（mmWave）系统的波束训练开销。然而，由此形成的传感与推理流程可能非常耗能，这促使人们考虑使用高能效的脉冲神经网络（SNN）来替代传统的人工神经网络（ANN）。在这项工作中，我们开发了用于波束预测的SNN架构，并在仅位置、仅视觉和多模态三种输入条件下将其与ANN进行了系统性比较。结果表明，对于仅位置传感，紧凑型ANN始终优于SNN；而对于视觉和多模态传感，SNN在相近能耗下可获得比ANN更高的精度，且在相当精度下能耗可降低多达一个数量级。例如，多模态SNN达到了58.08%的top-1精度，优于最接近的……
tldr: 该论文为毫米波传感辅助波束预测开发了脉冲神经网络（SNN），发现在视觉和多模态输入下，SNN能在相近能耗下取得比人工神经网络更高的精度，或在同等精度下将能耗降低多达一个数量级。
en_tdlr: This paper develops spiking neural networks (SNNs) for sensing-aided beam prediction, showing that with vision and multimodal inputs, SNNs achieve higher accuracy than ANNs at similar energy costs, or require up to an order of magnitude less energy at comparable accuracy.
